messages:
maria_cs: Hi team — customer report: CSV export from Console 'Organization usage' returns header row only, all subsequent rows are blank when they select a timezone other than UTC. Happens for multiple ranges. Attached sample and steps below.

luis_support: Thanks Maria. Can you paste the export job id and the exact timezone they picked?

maria_cs: job id: export_2026-03-17_9f7c2a, timezone: 'Pacific/Apia' (UTC+13). Steps: Console -> Analytics -> Organization usage -> custom range 2026-02-01..2026-02-28 -> timezone dropdown -> select Pacific/Apia -> Export CSV -> download. UI shows 2.1 KB in browser but file downloads as 48 bytes.

devon_prod: cc @sanjay_eng @anya_sre — intermittent or reproducible?

maria_cs: Reproducible in our staging with that timezone. Non-UTC zones seem to trigger it. When timezone left as UTC, CSV is fine.

export_bot: export_service: job export_2026-03-17_9f7c2a queued -> started -> wrote presigned URL -> uploaded object size=48 bytes -> status=complete

anya_sre: Can you paste a tiny output of the downloaded file? (hex or first few bytes)

maria_cs: Sure — downloaded file content (raw):
```
Organization,User,Tokens
,,,,
,,,,
```
That's literally header then a couple of comma-only lines. File size on S3 reported as 48 bytes.

sanjay_eng: Any chance Content-Encoding mismatch (gzip stored but served as identity) or truncated stream? Can you run `aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-exports --key exports/export_2026-03-17_9f7c2a.csv` and paste headers?

luis_support: I ran head-object: ContentLength: 48, ContentType: text/csv, ContentEncoding: (none), ETag: "d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e"

devon_prod: ETag looks like empty file md5... strange. Could the exporter be writing a temp gzip and moving wrong object for timezone path?

anya_sre: I'll tail the export worker logs for that job id and run a staging repro with Pacific/Apia. Can someone share the curl they used so I can hit the same endpoint?

maria_cs: curl we gave customer (console triggers same API):
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/exports?range=2026-02-01_2026-02-28&tz=Pacific/Apia&report=org_usage" \
  -o out.csv -v
```

sanjay_eng: Thanks. I'm seeing this in the export worker logs when tz != UTC: `split_timezones(): invalid offset conversion -> empty rows written` — looks like our aggregation path for non-UTC fell through to a fast-path that returns empty iterator. Putting a breakpoint.

anya_sre: While you debug, @maria_cs can you ask the customer to try two quick workarounds: 1) export with UTC timezone, 2) export with same timezone but via API (curl) instead of Console and share response headers. If API succeeds it's likely a client-side param encoding bug.

maria_cs: Will do. Customer tried API and got same blank rows. They pasted response headers: `Content-Type: text/csv`, `Content-Length: 48`, `x-export-job: export_2026-03-17_9f7c2a`

devon_prod: OK that's server-side. Sanjay, any ETA on a patch? Can we roll a hotfix to avoid returning empty iterator?

sanjay_eng: I have a fix locally: fallback to UTC aggregation when timezone conversion fails and emit a warning metric. Will open PR in ~30m. Patch will ensure export object isn't empty.

anya_sre: I'll prepare a canary rollout for export-worker nodes and watch job success rate and SLOs. Also adding a log metric: `export.timezone_fallback`

luis_support: Noted — I'll update the customer with a temporary workaround (use UTC) and share ticket id: #SUP-2026-1129. Will follow up when patch is live. :thumbsup:

maria_cs: Thanks all. Posting repro materials in the ticket. If someone can drop the PR link here when ready that'd be great.

sanjay_eng: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/exporter/pulls/412 — includes unit test for Pacific/Apia and an integration test that exercises timezone-aware aggregation.

devon_prod: Merged to hotfix branch and started rolling canary. Will ping when rollout passes health checks.

export_bot: deploy: hotfix/exporter-timezone-fallback -> canary(3/3) -> success

anya_sre: Canary good. No increased error rate and `export.timezone_fallback` metric shows 12 in last 10m (expected). Rolling to production now.

luis_support: Customer notified that fix is deployed. They confirmed successful CSV download with Pacific/Apia and file contains rows. Closing ticket in 24h if no regressions.

maria_cs: Great, thanks everyone. Closing loop.
